blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A mental health group on Friday criticized a bill seeking to restrict social media use among children below 18. It called the proposed measure a “non-solution” to keeping young people safe. The Senate, in a 16-1-0 vote, approved Senate Bill No. 2424, or the Safe Media Access and Responsible Technology for Kids in Digital Spaces (Smart Kids) Act. It seeks to protect children from the physical, mental, social and emotional harms associated with using social media platforms.
